explication: DADA2 is an R package for exact inference of amplicon sequence variants from high-throughput sequencing reads. Its principal workflow is read preparation, error-model learning, sample inference, paired-read handling and sequence-table cleanup, with taxonomy assignment as a downstream capability. The graph preserves these documented stages and the C++ inference internals. Most R-layer implementation was not excerpted, so those subsystem links are documented at a high level rather than traced through unsampled calls.
